title: Event Subscribe Trigger Node
description: Workflow entry point receiving events from a managed subscription. The transport (Kafka, …) is determined by the referenced Integration; transport-specific topic rules are enforced server-side.

topic.description: Topic/subject to subscribe to. Transport-specific naming rules (e.g. Kafka's charset and length limits) are enforced against the resolved Integration.

input_schema.description: Optional self-contained JSON Schema (Draft-07) for the event payload.

resultSchema.description: The supplied transport-neutral event envelope after ordinary output mapping.
